feature: Expanded local keyword rules with manual settings preservation and scoped service matching
behavior: Adds public merchant/service aliases for scooter, transit, telecom, markets, subscriptions, bank fees, personal care, clothing and university charges.
Legacy valid settings receive an effective in-memory merge without initial storage writes; existing category names, rule IDs, modes, targets and order remain intact.
Merge skips inactive category targets, existing normalized keywords and colliding IDs; no category is resurrected or existing rule replaced.
Trendyol Yemek/Market/Plus suppress only the exact untouched bundled general Trendyol suggestion. Edited/custom general rules remain active and can force suggestions.
New automatic rules cannot upgrade existing broader suggestion-only matches when no preexisting automatic rule matched.
Ambiguous transfers, cash, refunds, unresolved types, processor aliases and conflicting categories remain suggestions.
Bundled GRATIS requires a bank merchant label; explicit user rules remain literal. Bundled generic Google YouTube does not conflict with untouched YouTube Premium.
Explicit settings saves record optional keywordPackVersion=1; manually deleted additions remain deleted after reload and export/import.
Explicit Add bundled keywords operates on the manager draft, preserving existing rules and requiring the normal save.
Valid configurations over expansion count/byte limits remain effective unchanged with a notice; corrupt/unreadable settings suspend automatic matching.
Category suggestions never mutate financial data on startup. Existing history uses the normal preview/apply flow and new imports use preview/save.

compatibility.revision_guards: Original raw settings CAS token and Web Locks retained; financial writer unchanged.

test_fixture_change: Existing category-browser manual fixture declares keywordPackVersion=1; its 15 behavioral assertions remain unchanged. Separate 13-case gate tests actual legacy expansion.

user_sample.scope: Previously supplied JSON/XLSX matched and category rules evaluated read-only in memory.

limits: Merchant rules express editable bookkeeping conventions, not certainty about each purchased item.
Browser verification uses Chromium on Windows and mobile viewport emulation, not physical devices or manual screen readers.
Broad performance, source lifecycle, backfill and recovery suites were not rerun in full; existing category gates include targeted quota, concurrency and source-annotation checks.
CI configuration includes the keyword gate; external CI was not run.
packaging: User deferred new combined ZIP and off-PC backup; old snapshots retained.
